intentions.title: Give every organization enterprise-grade SSO: SAML 2.0 and OIDC relying-party login with per-org connections
intentions.evidence: saml.ex implements SP-initiated + IdP-initiated flows via the vetted esaml library (esaml_sp:validate_assertion, never hand-rolled XML-dsig); oidc.ex implements authorization-code+PKCE with RS256 id_token verification against the OP's JWKS. Both keyed per-org via saml_connection.ex / oidc_connection.ex (unique_constraint(:organization_id)).

intentions.title: Provision users just-in-time on first SSO login and keep their org role authoritatively synced from IdP group claims
intentions.evidence: oidc.ex handle_callback/3: Barkpark.Sso.resolve_group_role/2 maps id_token groups through admin-configured group_role_mappings (oidc_connection.ex); a resolved role calls jit_provision/3 + set_org_member_role/3 authoritatively (mirrors SCIM group sync per comments), an absent/unmapped groups claim leaves existing roles untouched.

intentions.title: Never let a token's group claim name an arbitrary role — mapping targets must resolve to a known built-in or admin-defined Role
intentions.evidence: oidc.ex create_connection/1 calls validate_mapping_roles/1 -> known_role?/2, checking against Membership.roles() or an existing Role scoped to the org's workspaces, before insert — guards the bypass since authoritative role sync writes via update_all which skips the membership changeset.

intentions.title: Support full SAML Single Logout (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated) so a session ends everywhere, not just locally
intentions.evidence: saml.ex: slo_available?/1, sp_logout_redirect_url/4 (SP-initiated, generate_logout_request), consume_logout_request/3 (IdP-initiated, validate_logout_request with idp_signs_logout_requests: true — 'an unsigned logout would let anyone kill sessions'), logout_response_html/2 (auto-submit POST binding back to IdP).

intentions.title: Let organizations auto-route employees to their own SSO by verified email domain, never trusting an unverified claim
intentions.evidence: domains.ex: request_verification/2 issues a DNS TXT token (barkpark-verify=...), verify/1 confirms via Resolver.txt_records/1, route_for_email/1 only returns an org when verified_at is non-nil ('Only a verified domain routes'). domains/resolver.ex swaps :inet_res for a fake resolver in tests.

intentions.title: Offer social login (Google, GitHub, Microsoft) that links into the same User identity graph without creating duplicate accounts
intentions.evidence: social.ex unifies three providers under one OAuth2+userinfo flow (@endpoints map); find_or_link/3: existing (provider, external_id) re-logs the same account, otherwise email find-or-creates a User and links a SocialIdentity — 'never a duplicate of an existing email account'.

intentions.title: Isolate every outbound IdP/provider HTTP call behind a swappable HTTP module so SSO protocol logic is fully testable against mock IdPs
intentions.evidence: oidc.ex and social.ex route all token-exchange/userinfo/JWKS calls through Barkpark.Sso.Oidc.HTTP / Barkpark.Sso.Social.HTTP (oidc/http.ex, social/http.ex); moduledoc states 'tests stand in a mock IdP' and 'the protocol logic here is fully covered by tests against a mock OP', with live-IdP quirks called out as the remaining manual step.
